mapper.select: SELECT POLICY_ID AS "policyId", ISSUER AS "issuer", AUDIENCE AS "audience", ACCESS_TOKEN_VALID_MINUTES AS "accessTokenValidMinutes", REFRESH_TOKEN_VALID_HOURS AS "refreshTokenValidHours", ALGORITHM AS "algorithm", CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS AS "clockSkewSeconds", DENYLIST_CHECK_ENABLED AS "denylistCheckEnabled", REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATION_ENABLED AS "refreshTokenRotationEnabled", UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt", UPDATED_BY AS "updatedBy" FROM TCF_JWT_SECURITY_POLICY WHERE POLICY_ID = #{policyId}
